_about: Play's galleries. Daydreams are AI-made series; From Above is Christian's real drone photography. picks = item numbers in each shared Google Photos album (see tools/gallery.py). Daily Dose of Paradise is pulled from YouTube when publishing.
tools: Made with AI: Google Flow, OpenArt, Veo and Seedance, depending on the piece.

youtube.title: Daily Dose of Paradise
youtube.about: Short videos from real mornings, trails and lake days around the Carson Valley and Lake Tahoe, usually with Marley.

above.title: From Above
above.about: Nearly a decade of flying, from Oʻahu's reefs to the Donegal coast. Real photographs, shot as an FAA Part 107 certified drone pilot since 2018.

captions.4: Sunrise over the Mokulua islands, Oʻahu

daydreams.title: Carnelian Concepts
daydreams.about: Two halves. The real stones, found a little at a time and lit from below, and the AI daydreams they set off: fire armor, glowing kitchens, carnelian headphones.

daydreams.title: Fake Tahoe
daydreams.about: Lake Tahoe as a tilt-shift model railway: tiny boats, tiny beaches, all of it made with AI.

daydreams.title: Under the Surface
daydreams.about: Each scene is a famous film, under water. Can you name them?

daydreams.title: Marley and Me
daydreams.about: Marley, the dog from the lake scene, and Christian on adventures neither of them has actually been on.

daydreams.title: E-Bike Expedition Concepts
daydreams.about: Camper trailers sized for an e-bike, for nights out a long way from the car.

daydreams.title: Illuminated Desk Topper
daydreams.about: A lit onyx top for a standing desk: the light-jar idea at furniture size, worked out as a concept with build drawings.

daydreams.title: Terrarium Head Newts
daydreams.about: Newts with tiny gardens growing in glass domes on their heads.

daydreams.title: Autoped Scooter, 1915
daydreams.about: The 1915 Autoped was one of the first motor scooters. These are AI re-imaginings of it in use, not archive photographs.

daydreams.title: Reno, 1882
daydreams.about: One 1882 photograph of Virginia Street and Second Street, and AI renders built from it: the same street from other angles, and the people in it, to see what they saw.

daydreams.title: Action Grandpa
daydreams.about: Made for my stepdad, who loves every one of these and posts them himself.

daydreams.title: Mega T2 VW Van
daydreams.about: A lifted 1970s VW camper built for a friend in London. He laughed, which was the point.

daydreams.title: Wave Riders
daydreams.about: Over-under shots of surfers and paddlers, every one of them AI. Keep Tahoe Blue is the League to Save Lake Tahoe's motto.

daydreams.title: Silly Boats
daydreams.about: Things that should not float, floating.

daydreams.title: Taco Time
daydreams.about: Tacos in places tacos should not be: Lake Tahoe, a zen garden, a tsunami.
